AOTViewDescription: This view aggregates sales data for users eligible for a specific promotion, including their targets and rewards.
AOTViewWithLevel:
SELECT
  "sales"."userId",
  "users"."username",
  "userTargets"."target" as "userTarget",
  "userTargets"."reward",
  "userTargets"."level",
  "vw_promotion_eligible_audience"."promotionId",
  sum("sales"."quantity") as "totalSalesQuantity",
  sum("sales"."value") as "totalSalesValue"
FROM
  "users" as "users"
  inner join "vw_promotion_eligible_audience" as "vw_promotion_eligible_audience" ON (
    "users"."id" = "vw_promotion_eligible_audience"."userId"
  )
  inner join "sales" as "sales" ON (
    "vw_promotion_eligible_audience"."userId" = "sales"."userId"
  )
  inner join "products" as "products" ON ("sales"."productId" = "products"."id")
  inner join "eligibleProductRewards" as "eligibleProductRewards" ON (
    "products"."externalIdentifier" = "eligibleProductRewards"."productAttributeValue"
    AND "vw_promotion_eligible_audience"."promotionId" = "eligibleProductRewards"."promotionId"
  )
  inner join "userTargets" as "userTargets" ON (
    "vw_promotion_eligible_audience"."userId" = "userTargets"."userId"
    AND "vw_promotion_eligible_audience"."promotionId" = "userTargets"."promotionId"
  )
WHERE
  (
    "vw_promotion_eligible_audience"."promotionId" = '{{promotionId}}'
    and "eligibleProductRewards"."promotionId" = '{{promotionId}}'
    and "userTargets"."promotionId" = '{{promotionId}}'
  )
  and ("products"."productStatus" = '1')
  and ("users"."status" = 'Online')
GROUP BY
  "sales"."userId",
  "users"."username",
  "userTargets"."target",
  "userTargets"."reward",
  "userTargets"."level",
  "vw_promotion_eligible_audience"."promotionId"
